system_thesis_interpretation: Operationally, v2 has four state classes but retains only the three cognitive functions named by the thesis. THINK is transient generation plus the child's model-owned notes and harness-maintained public state; DREAM is deterministic reconstruction or derivation of a finite active context and compiler views from committed records, not another learned organ; personal SLEEP is a response-only LoRA write over supported child-authored action/outcome experience; and the schooling bootstrap is an upstream, non-personal initialization artifact merged into immutable birth weights. The unique architecture-level ancestry is now M0 -> BT or BD -> one FP32 reference merge and one BF16 rounding -> immutable M_birth_T or M_birth_D -> repeated fresh zero-effective-delta personal adapters trained from that birth on the committed cumulative data closure. The prior personal adapter is a state/evaluation parent, not a weight initializer. Live parent text may change waking behavior but must not itself enter personal SLEEP inputs or targets; only later supported child continuations and dispatched public outcomes can cross the compiler boundary. This graph is constructible in principle and uniquely excludes stacking or bootstrap optimizer inheritance. It is not yet uniquely executable from current bytes: exact checkpoint/tokenizer/toolchain roots, module inventory, serializer/root-hash encoding, support resolver, transaction state machine, generators, rubrics, ages, and statistical procedure remain future bound inputs, and every existing organism_v6 writer/runtime/lineage path violates at least one successor invariant. No current source or evidence implements or certifies v2.
graph_delta_interpretation: The canonical data spine must be typed and content-addressed: immutable public dispatch/outcome occurrences become evidence IDs; a clause-level resolver derives episodic, corrective, or multi-evidence generalized lesson IDs; a renderer derives native view IDs; an encoder derives input/label/mask and supervised-exposure identities; and the writer derives a candidate adapter and evaluation transaction. Counts at each edge are noninterchangeable. For bootstrap, one arm-independent canonical transition and permanent pair ID precede both renderings. T contains exactly one declared feedback computation; D receives and executes the same canonical action without any of the six computations; action, public outcome, supervised-token count, action-token position, batch/update slot, and admission decision are paired, while arm-specific attended conditioning and loss-bearing computation spans are acknowledged treatment differences. BT and BD are provenance artifacts retained for audit but never mounted in personal life after their one merge. M0 remains a diagnostic rather than a third causal match. For personal SLEEP, a complete staged closure contains evidence, resolver, lessons, views, encoded batches, fresh initializer, candidate tensors, evaluation, and decision; a compare-and-swap head alone makes that closure readable by later compilation, parent/context rendering, probing, or selection. Disposable advice and exam clones have no edge back to that head. Current organism_v6 has none of this complete graph: ledger rows use repeatable episode IDs without immutable occurrence IDs; compile_sleep and compile_native deduplicate strings or answers rather than preserve support identities; compile_native can store the full rendered prompt; train_adapter.py and train_adapter_v21.py are different writers; loaders resolve a mutable environment model and do not bind adapter-to-birth; run_life variants and classroom_round discover latest artifacts by directory/marker; and no merge builder, detached checkpoint manifest, CAS head, or closure validator exists. The least risky implementation would therefore be a new successor-only path that rejects legacy fallbacks, with legacy files treated solely as evidence of the before-state.
loop_delta_interpretation: There are four ordered loops. First, after future authority, bootstrap construction freezes allowlisted generators and canonical pairs, renders T/D rows, performs full-sequence semantic and encoded-dose audits, trains the two adapters through the sole writer, merges each once into the same verified M0, and seals two birth roots before downstream instance generation. Second, waking produces temporary context, child text, parsed dispatches, and public outcomes; only committed, mechanically supported child evidence can feed a personal compiler. Each personal SLEEP starts from its arm's birth with fresh factor and optimizer state, trains on the committed cumulative data closure, compares the resulting child against the exact previous committed child and frozen safety panel, and either CAS-promotes the entire new closure or leaves the prior head byte-identical. The proposal still needs to decide whether wake evidence and adaptive-parent state created before a rejected write are themselves rolled back or quarantined, because this determines the next compiler and parent history. Third, repetition is a parent-side state machine keyed by immutable lesson ID: reminders span varied relevant cases, uncued enactment and irrelevant use are scored, a reset pass is required before fade, and only a frozen relapse condition restores the lesson. Current parent_brief instead demands a repeated first NOTE and measures lexical overlap, so it is evidence for the retired behavior rather than reusable implementation. Fourth, standardized advice uses same-state disposable clones before personal SLEEP; fixed-policy development holds lesson bytes and opportunities exogenous while allowing treatment-induced child traces and personal writes to differ; adaptive development estimates the full parent+child+SLEEP package with all parent information/effort recorded; cadence is deferred until those cheaper gates pass and is limited to a randomized total package plus conditional terminal-ledger descriptions. The cheapest implementation sequence is authority and statistic/specification freeze; model-free evidence, initializer, manifest, lineage-fault, visibility-taint, repetition, and mock-clone fixtures; tokenizer-only route/mask/dose fixtures; paired-source and semantic audits; target-checkpoint merge/birth routing and all remaining pre-GPU receipts; fresh independent review and separate human GPU authority; then one-root/two-seed writer safety, second-root survivor confirmation, rank-by-exposure, immediate receptivity, fixed-policy learning, adaptive ecology, optional personal-retention evidence, and finally cadence. Passing any stage licenses only the separately approved next packet, never automatic execution.
claim_delta_interpretation: The retired R2/write-swarm evidence has no successor credit because the current long-life path still invokes the rank-16 bare-text writer and the swarm changes row/exposure count. The only headline-eligible future claim is conditional experiential storage/extraction/use, and it requires three distinct observables: exact-source reproduction, held-out-cue extraction without text access, and improved native action on fresh homologous tasks under semantic binding controls and preservation. Immediate Delta_R supports only selective standardized advice use at birth. Delta_F supports faster learning from one byte-fixed teaching curriculum with personal SLEEP included. Delta_E supports amplification of the selected adaptive parent+child+SLEEP package, not parenting alone, a stable child trait, or a weight-only mediator. Computation-level repetition is descriptive unless independently randomized. Rank 8 versus 16 estimates only capacity by supervised exposure for the selected writer, not generic plasticity or age. Natural K4 versus K1 estimates only the total cadence package; standardized terminal rewrites describe consequences of different induced ledgers under one writer and do not identify natural direct or indirect mediation. Two-root margins are spend screens; scientific claims require at least six new independent roots and a separately frozen analysis. No implementation, model output, benchmark result, adapter, birth, or claim presently exists under this proposal.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The intended firewall is strict. Bootstrap process conditioning may be visible to the builder and attended by the birth writer while its tokens are loss-masked; it disappears after merge. Longitudinal live parent bytes may be visible only during parent-present waking and to the isolated auditor. Under the matrix's explicit forbidden cell, those bytes cannot appear anywhere in a personal SLEEP input sequence, including a loss-masked prompt; a restricted nonreversible provenance reference may be stored outside compiler views. Current compile_native copies ledger prompt bytes into q, run_life_v2 appends parent briefs to the waking bootstrap, nursery_dialogue inserts parent/restatement text into prompts, and classroom_round directly targets child restatements, so all current paths must be rejected rather than grandfathered. Child grounded traces can cross into SLEEP only after public dispatch/outcome support; private evaluation scores remain reporting-only and may not affect child, parent, compiler, selection, or later roots. Disposable exam and advice transcripts must be absent from the continuing ledger. The isolated auditor may see both sides of the final/bootstrap boundary but may return only an untainted release decision bound to the already-built bootstrap root and policy/identity; no final-derived hash, name, timing, seed, cache key, or diagnostic may enter builder or birth inputs. One matrix cell is internally unsafe as written: final.public_observation is visible to SLEEP_COMPILER even though final/deployment examinations are described as disposable and reporting-only. Developmental public observations that may become personal evidence and final evaluation observations that must not must be separate information items before implementation.
acceptance_test_interpretation: V2_ES01_EXACT_AUTHORITY: the change and all ten declared context bindings validate at their exact hashes now, but the intake is only collecting interpretations and no consensus, human ratification, or enumerated implementation scope exists; this interpretation creates none. V2_ES02_EVIDENCE_SUPPORT_VIEW_IDENTITY: the advertised link is correct only if two validators operate on immutable occurrence IDs and clause-level ordered support; current episode IDs, string/answer deduplication, winner admission, synthesized principles, and whole-response targets fail it. V2_ES03_EXACT_WRITER_ROUTE_MASK_AND_DOSE: build a sole successor entry point and fail every legacy/default route; current writers differ in rank, loss, dropout, batch size, epochs, LR, truncation, nonfinite handling, data order, token counts, and callers, so neither qualifies. Exact equality can cover encoded opportunity and named paired spans, never realized gradients or Adam moments. V2_ES04_ZERO_EFFECTIVE_DELTA_INITIALIZER: this is cheaply and uniquely testable with A sampled from the bound normal and B exactly zero, paired tensor hashes, null optimizer state, a flowing gradient, and an all-zero/all-zero failure fixture; current PEFT defaults are not evidence. V2_ES05_BIRTH_MERGE_AND_CONTENT_IDENTITY: the FP32 product/add and one BF16 rounding topology is constructible and removes stack ambiguity, but real execution must await exact M0, tensor/tie inventory, serializer/toolchain, canonical directory-root encoding, parity tolerance, and symmetric rounding gate; tiny fake tensors and fake shards should be proved first. V2_ES06_LINEAGE_BINDING_AND_TRANSACTION_FAULTS: require birth validation before model import and one CAS-visible closure across every data/context/evaluation store. Existing DONE/REJECTED marker renames and directory scans demonstrably allow rejected corpora or briefs into later state and are not reusable as the commit mechanism. V2_ES07_DIRECT_CONTROL_PAIR_AND_SEMANTIC_AUDIT: permanent pre-render pairs, action replay, exact action/outcome/slot identity, and a full attended prompt+target audit measure the advertised package contrast. Exact generators, row allocation, difficulty strata, rubric fixtures, coder identities, and adjudication remain unbound; D cannot be called semantically equal or neutral. V2_ES08_INCREMENTAL_TARGET_BLINDNESS: dependency closure, hermetic mounts, temporal freeze, structural tables, renamed-clone failure, action-equivalence advice limits, and auditor-only final mutation together can test incremental nondependence. They cannot establish that M0 lacks prior task knowledge, and the proposed Boolean rule family must not be declared unrelated to the current RuleGame without passing the structural audit. V2_ES09_STANDARDIZED_ADVICE_RECEPTIVITY: four disposable same-state clones avoid the predecessor's sequential-attempt confound; primary scoring must be the mechanically dispatched action/outcome, with correct/none defining Delta_R and frozen null/redirection predictions for irrelevant/wrong advice. The harness and clean no-write clone boundary do not exist today. V2_ES10_FIXED_POLICY_LEARNING: byte-identical advice, tasks, timing, resources, exam folds, write schedule, writer configuration, and exogenous optimizer opportunity can identify learning from the same curriculum. Exact personal write bytes cannot and should not match when births produce different grounded ledgers; the acceptance wording must be read as identical opportunities/mechanism, not identical corpora, gradients, adapters, or decisions. V2_ES11_ADAPTIVE_PACKAGE_ACCELERATION: the current parent prototypes do not provide resource-matched solo cells, disposable clean exams, fixed panels, or complete information/effort receipts. A future passing interaction supports only the named ecological package and must keep personal SLEEP as an intended mediator. V2_ES12_REPETITION_ENACTMENT_FADE_AND_RELAPSE: implement a model-free lesson state machine first and make action selectivity, reset, fade, relapse, and restoration mechanical. The current forced first-NOTE/lexical-overlap behavior is a negative fixture; live parent bytes must never enter personal writer input IDs. V2_ES13_STORAGE_EXTRACTION_USE_AND_CONTROLS: the existing absorption probe measures response-masked NLL on replayed source rows and a wrong-life-like control only; it cannot establish held-out extraction or native use. Freeze separate scores and per-control directional predictions before writer evidence, and do not call STATE_ONLY direct supervision recollection. V2_ES14_PERSONAL_UNREPLAYED_RETENTION: a personal evidence sentinel needs an explicit compiler exclusion that later cumulative closures preserve; current cumulative corpus discovery replays earlier rows, and inherited bootstrap content is ineligible for this construct. V2_ES15_RANK_BY_EXPOSURE_ONLY: after compiler selection, compare rank 8/16 under equal supervised exposure, fixed alpha/r and module set, and unchanged roots/evaluation; current rank paths change other writer settings and cannot be interpreted. Treat the outcome as engineering capacity-by-exposure only. V2_ES16_CADENCE_TOTAL_AND_STANDARDIZED_LEDGER: defer until every cheaper gate and new authority passes. Current K4/K1-like lives differ in writer, data, seeds, briefs, and gates; only future natural randomization supports a total package label, while terminal rewrites remain conditional descriptions. V2_ES17_PRIMARY_STATISTICS_AND_SPEND_ORDER: the proposal freezes binary failure handling and practical margins, but exact ages, folds, AUC normalization bytes, threshold, interval, multiplicity, termination, mixed-sign edge cases, and six-root analysis remain to be bound before generation. Cheapest scientific spend after all pre-GPU gates is writer safety on one root/two seeds, a second root only for survivors, rank/exposure, Delta_R, Delta_F, Delta_E, optional personal retention, and cadence last. V2_ES18_FRESH_REVIEW_AND_GPU_GATE: after exact scoped implementation, CPU/tokenizer/data dry runs, and all lowest-cost predecessors, a fresh independent reviewer may veto; the separate advocate cannot override, and only a later human decision over an exact GPU packet can authorize a run. No pass or interpretation automatically advances a stage.
assumptions: M0 will be an exactly identified, locally materializable BF16 causal-language-model checkpoint whose every intended q/k/v/o/gate/up/down projection exists and whose tokenizer/chat-template files can be sealed with it.

A cumulative personal write means a fresh adapter and fresh optimizer on the immutable birth trained over the entire committed cumulative personal data closure; the prior personal adapter is used only as state ancestry and a behavioral preservation comparator.
The microdomains and every later advice/development/evaluation domain will be newly source-bound rather than inferred from the current RuleGame or CompilerGym prototypes.

A canonical transition has a replayable normalized action and public outcome under a pinned environment; stochastic outcomes, if allowed, require the same bound environment randomness in both pair arms.
Content-addressed roots, manifests, receipts, and CAS heads are declarative audit state outside the three cognitive functions, not additional memory organs visible to the child.

All implementation-order recommendations are conditional planning only and do not authorize creating code, invoking a tokenizer/model, generating a corpus/benchmark, training an adapter, using a GPU, acquiring resources, or making a claim.

The current untracked organism_v6 and successor-change files are read-only evidence supplied in the shared workspace; this interpretation does not treat git tracking state as authority or modify those files.

ambiguities.question: Which exact M0/tokenizer/chat-template roots, dependency versions, parameter traversal order, precision/autocast behavior, RNG namespaces, serializer, and configuration encoding instantiate the otherwise explicit writer recipe?
ambiguities.impact: Until a later exact packet binds them, multiple byte- and sometimes behavior-distinct writers satisfy the prose; the architecture topology is unique but executable construction and receipts are not.

ambiguities.question: What canonical manifest serialization/root derivation, allowed-file registry, sharding parameters, tied-tensor restoration rule, fixed-input set, and numeric/asymmetry threshold define birth identity and acceptable BF16 merge loss?
ambiguities.impact: Different manifests or serializers can give different roots, and post-hoc tolerance choice can admit a vanished or asymmetrically rounded schooling delta.

ambiguities.question: When a personal candidate is rejected, are the preceding wake evidence, child notes, parent messages, parent playbook changes, and acquisition/fade state rolled back, committed independently, or permanently quarantined with the failed candidate?
ambiguities.impact: This determines the actual next child context, parent policy, cumulative data parent, and meaning of the invariant that rejected data and context never influence the future.

ambiguities.question: What exact clause segmentation, temporal availability, correction linkage, duplicate-occurrence, episode-independence, generalized-support threshold, conflict, and scope-escalation rules are shared by the two support validators?
ambiguities.impact: Without these rules a favorable outcome can still validate unsupported thought text, valid failures may be lost, and independently implemented validators can disagree without a defined disposition.

ambiguities.question: Which exact versioned generator sources, schemas, rewards, structural-overlap table, train/calibration splits, row allocation across six computations and four families, demonstrator, and downstream assay families realize the 192-240 pairs?
ambiguities.impact: The named family labels do not uniquely construct data or prove disjointness, and Boolean rule discovery may be policy-isomorphic to the current RuleGame.

ambiguities.question: Does 'identical writes' in the fixed-policy test mean equal schedules/writer/exogenous exposure, or exact equality of selected corpora and candidate artifacts?
ambiguities.impact: The latter is impossible without suppressing the treatment-induced experiential pathway; the former is the constructible and causally relevant balance.

ambiguities.question: Are final.public_observation bytes produced by disposable reporting-only evaluation, or by a continuing wake episode eligible for later personal SLEEP?
ambiguities.impact: The matrix currently permits SLEEP access while the assay prose forbids exam feedback; one choice risks evaluation leakage and the other makes the visible cell false.

ambiguities.question: What exact developmental ages, parallel folds, AUC normalization, absolute threshold, interval and multiplicity procedure, early-termination rule, missing-data rule, and disposition of positive-but-submargin or same-sign root disagreement will be frozen?
ambiguities.impact: The stated margins and root counts alone do not make Delta_R, Delta_F, Delta_E, retention, or cadence analyses reproducible or prevent endpoint selection.

ambiguities.question: For each bootstrap birth and personal candidate, which exact comparison set and bound apply against M0, the arm's birth, and the previous committed child on interface, work-turn, generic, and task panels?
ambiguities.impact: Different baselines can accept regression relative to the actual parent or reject harmless schooling differences; the -0.05 phrase does not fully define multi-panel promotion.

ambiguities.question: What frozen M0 difficulty tolerance defines 'grossly easier,' and does failure terminate this proposal or permit the orthogonal-computation control mentioned only in the rework resolution?
ambiguities.impact: Adding a third active control after observing calibration changes the graph and estimand, while lacking a threshold leaves semantic-control failure discretionary.

ambiguities.question: Who are the two independently identified coders, what exact six-computation positive/negative/ambiguous rubric and multilabel rule do they use, and who adjudicates disagreements without returning tunable row feedback to builders?
ambiguities.impact: A nominal 100%/0% result is not reproducible and can conceal prompt-only contamination or iterative corpus tuning without a frozen audit contract.

ambiguities.question: What on-disk head representation, same-filesystem assumption, locking/CAS primitive, fsync ordering, concurrent-writer rule, and recovery behavior defines one atomic promotion on supported platforms?
ambiguities.impact: Rename alone is not a complete durability or stale-writer protocol; different filesystems and multi-process races can expose a partial or non-monotone closure.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The merge-once birth topology is uniquely selected, but the proposal is not yet an exact constructible implementation and should not be described as one exact writer or immutable content identity until its future roots, encodings, tolerances, resolver, and transaction protocol are bound.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Current organism_v6 supplies multiple incompatible writer routes and no birth merge/root/CAS implementation. Several proposal tests deliberately defer normative constants and source identities to later packets, so more than one executable byte graph still conforms to the prose.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Treat v2 as a ratifiable architecture only. After consensus and human architecture approval, create a separately scoped exact implementation contract with every deferred value and require any material choice that changes graph, visibility, tests, or claims to restart deliberation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The fixed-policy requirement for 'identical writes' is incorrect if it means identical personal corpora, gradients, adapters, or gate decisions across births.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The treatment is intended to change child thought/action/outcome traces, which are the sole personal SLEEP source. Forcing identical realized writes would either import one arm's experience into the other or remove the feedback-to-learning pathway being tested.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require identical write timing, writer bytes, initialized opportunity, supervised-token/update budget, gates, and compiler rules; allow and report treatment-induced grounded ledger/view/candidate differences, and phrase the estimand as the same teaching and SLEEP mechanism rather than the same realized write.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The PARENT_TO_CHILD_TO_SLEEP edge's phrase 'parent prose is context-only and response-loss-masked' conflicts with the visibility matrix's stronger rule that life.live_parent_text is forbidden and never ingested by the personal SLEEP compiler.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A loss-masked prompt still causally conditions response-token gradients. Current compile_native and classroom paths demonstrate the risk by copying a parent-containing waking prompt into q; this would make parent prose an attended personal training input even though it is not a target.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Reserve attended loss-masked parent conditioning for the separate bootstrap writer only. Strip/redact live longitudinal parent bytes from every personal SLEEP input_id before rendering, retain only restricted audit provenance outside the compiler DAG, and test their absence from both prompts and labels.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: final.public_observation should not be visible to SLEEP_COMPILER when it denotes a sealed deployment or disposable exam observation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: All three bootstrap assays rely on clean disposable exams whose outputs cannot enter the continuing child, parent, ledger, or compiler. The current visibility cell instead creates a feedback edge from final evaluation into personal learning.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Split developmental.public_observation, which may become supported personal evidence, from evaluation.public_observation, which is reporting-only and forbidden to SLEEP; update the exact visibility product before implementation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The four named microdomains cannot yet be called unrelated to all downstream assays, especially Boolean rule discovery relative to the existing RuleGame.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Different nouns and action tokens do not exclude a one-to-one hidden-rule/query/update policy isomorphism, and exact successor generator and downstream split sources do not yet exist in the bound context.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Call the four families proposed candidates until exact sources and downstream domains pass the structural-overlap/renamed-clone audit. Any failed family is excluded through new ratified bytes; it is not repaired by post-hoc renaming or selection.
